{{Top|leg}}
'''Mandalorian wristdarts''' or '''wristdarts''' were a prized collectors weapon that came in matched sets.

Consisting of wristlets that fitted around the wrist by means of a clasp, the wristlets contained a spring mechanism that would fire a profusion of tiny and deadly darts when the wearer moved their fingers a certain way. Deadly by themselves, the darts could additionally be poisoned.

The [[t'landa Til]] [[Teroenza]] once offered a pair of matched set wristdarts to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], simply to gain an audience with him. Later, Boba Fett would poison one set with a [[Neurotoxin/Legends|Neurotoxin]], and the other with a soporific; though he never got the chance to use them on his target, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].
